sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Broadband Cellular Routers and Optical Terminals

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France has a network of bilateral investment treaties and double-taxation agreements; treaty protection or tax treaty entitlement must be determined by the investor's country of residence, treaty status, investment structure, and applicable denial-of-benefits provisions.
The France-China bilateral investment treaty signed in 1984 is in force, subject to its text and applicable interpretation.

France is a member of the European Union; EU single-market and customs rules may apply to qualifying intra-EU activities, but do not replace French incorporation, tax, product-compliance, or AML requirements.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Core AML/CFT framework: Code monétaire et financier, including Articles L.561-2 et seq. and L.561-46 et seq., as amended; beneficial-owner identification and filing are governed principally by Code monétaire et financier Articles L.561-2-2 and L.561-46 and Code de commerce Articles R.561-1 et seq. and R.561-55 et seq., together with implementing provisions and EU AML legislation. A SAS must identify its beneficial owners and file the prescribed information through the French company-formality system for entry in the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation or current company-register extract for each non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry or competent public authority in the entity's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing state and France are parties to the Apostille Convention; otherwise Consular Legalization, subject to any applicable treaty exemption

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Constitutional documents and current director or authorized-signatory evidence for each non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company secretary, notary, company registry, or other competent authority in the country of origin, as applicable
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for public documents where available; otherwise Consular Legalization. Private documents may require notarization before apostille or legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney authorizing the French incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized signatory of the foreign principal; notarization by a competent notary may be required for the chosen authentication route
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if eligible; otherwise Consular Legalization, followed by French translation by a sworn translator where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Identity and address evidence for foreign natural-person founders, directors, and beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Government identity authority, bank, utility provider, or other accepted issuer, depending on the document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization only where the document's nature and filing authority require it; provide a French sworn translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: French registered-office evidence, such as a commercial lease, domiciliation agreement, or premises-use authorization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Landlord, approved domiciliation provider, or property holder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No foreign-document authentication ordinarily applies; foreign-issued evidence, if exceptionally used, may require apostille or legalization and French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Conduct documented, risk-based screening of founders, directors, signatories, beneficial owners, and relevant counterparties against applicable French and EU restrictive-measures lists, UN Security Council sanctions, and, where relevant to the transaction or financial institution, OFAC lists. Identify domestic and foreign politically exposed persons (PEPs), family members, and known close associates; apply enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds checks, senior-management approval, and ongoing monitoring where legally required. French obliged entities must apply the Code monétaire et financier and applicable EU rules; OFAC screening is not a universal French statutory requirement but may be required by US nexus, contract, or bank policy.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), with company registration processed through the competent Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS) and INPI data systems
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be stated in the articles of association and filings in a form accepted by French registries. French diacritics and other characters supported by the filing system may be used. A SAS must include the legal form or the designation Société par actions simplifiée, or the permitted abbreviation SAS, in its constitutive documents and commercial identification. Foreign-language or transliterated names are not categorically prohibited, but must be distinguishable, lawful, and not misleading or infringing.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Terms implying a regulated activity or status, including banque, bank, assurance, insurer, investment-services designations, and other protected or regulated professional terms, where their use is restricted by law or requires authorization
Official designations or wording suggesting a public authority, state institution, or international organization, where such use is prohibited or misleading
Names infringing an existing company name, trade name, trademark, or other protected right
Names contrary to public order, public policy, or applicable laws
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not provide a general statutory company-name reservation period equivalent to a fixed 30-day reservation. Before filing, search the INPI trademark database, RCS and other relevant business-name sources, and domain names; these searches do not guarantee availability or freedom to use. If a registration or name-related filing is rejected, obtain the written decision and stated grounds, correct the filing or submit supporting evidence through the Guichet unique as appropriate, and use the appeal route and deadline stated in the decision. A decision of the competent registry clerk may generally be challenged before the president of the competent commercial court under the applicable procedural rules; obtain French counsel to confirm the competent forum, standing, and deadline for the specific decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A SAS must have a French registered office. Domiciliation at a commercial domiciliation provider is generally permitted if the provider is authorized and the statutory domiciliation requirements are met. A registered-office address alone does not establish operational substance. For a telecom-equipment OEM, maintain evidence appropriate to actual functions, including personnel, premises or contract-manufacturing arrangements, inventory and logistics records, accounting, decision-making, product-compliance files, and customer and supplier activity. Product manufacturing, importing, or placing equipment on the EU market may trigger separate obligations, including applicable CE marking and Radio Equipment Directive requirements; incorporation does not itself grant a telecom operating authorization.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No reliable public statistic quantifies the probability of an unannounced inspection for a SAS or this industry. Inspection risk is fact-specific and may arise from tax, labor, customs, product-safety, market-surveillance, or AML/CFT supervision. A mail-only or unsupported address increases compliance and bank-onboarding risk; no numerical probability is asserted.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI Guichet unique filing, RCS registration, and beneficial-owner filing charges
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI, competent RCS registry, and applicable public or delegated filing authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative estimate converted from applicable French administrative and registry charges; exact fees vary by filing type and are subject to the current tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory legal announcement of SAS formation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized journal for legal announcements in the relevant French department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative statutory or regulated tariff estimate; amount depends on the applicable tariff and announcement requirements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial name, trademark, and domain-name clearance searches
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Basic official searches may be free; estimate allows for professional clearance review at prevailing market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French corporate-law drafting and incorporation assistance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French avocat, notaire, or qualified corporate-service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative prevailing market benchmark; scope, ownership complexity, and negotiation of bespoke articles materially affect fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign corporate-document notarization, apostille, or consular legalization
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary and competent apostille or consular authorities in the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative estimate only; varies substantially by issuing country, document count, expedited processing, and authentication route

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn French translations of foreign-language incorporation and ownership documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French sworn translator or translator authorized for the relevant filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per page or document; translation volume and language determine final cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office domiciliation for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized French domiciliation provider or landlord
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative prevailing market benchmark; location, mail handling, meeting facilities, and service level affect pricing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Founder, director, beneficial-owner, and corporate-shareholder AML/KYC screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French incorporation adviser, compliance provider, or financial institution
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative prevailing market benchmark; screening depth, number of persons, and adverse-media review affect pricing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial product-regulatory scoping for wireless routers and optical terminals
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French or EU product-compliance counsel or testing/compliance adviser
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative professional-services benchmark; excludes laboratory testing, certification, engineering remediation, and ongoing compliance costs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title II, Chapter VII, Articles L.227-1 through L.227-20 governing the Société par Actions Simplifiée (SAS); Articles L.123-1 to L.123-33 and R.123-104 to R.123-116 on registration and publicity; Decree No. 2021-300 on the electronic Guichet Unique; Code de l'environnement, Book V (ICPE) for site licensing.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry of the Commercial Court) having jurisdiction over the registered office, served electronically through the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises operated by the INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'entreprise (M0) filed in the single electronic formation dossier together with the signed Statuts; registration is evidenced by the Extrait K-bis (company identity certificate).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital (freely fixed in the Statuts); cash contributions must be paid up to at least 50% at incorporation with the balance within five years; the funds are blocked on a dedicated French bank account or with a notary until registration and released upon issuance of the K-bis, evidenced by the certificate of the depositary (certificat du dépositaire des fonds).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The shareholders unanimously approve the subscription of the share capital set out in the Statuts and acknowledge that the cash contributions have been deposited with [bank/notary]; (2) the registered office is adopted at [address] and the President is authorized to execute any lease or authorization for those premises; (3) [Name] is appointed Président of the SAS for an indefinite term, with the fullest powers to act on behalf of the company; (4) [Name/firm] is appointed Commissaire aux Comptes for six fiscal years where statutory thresholds are met; (5) the incorporation dossier for the Guichet Unique, including the legal announcement and the K-bis application, is approved and filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and execution of the articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI company and trademark register (data.inpi.fr); shareholders, acting with or without a notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Screen the proposed corporate name against existing national denominations and trademark records; execute the Statuts in as many originals as required, signed by all shareholders; where an asset is contributed in kind, appoint a contributory appraiser (commissaire aux apports) whose report is annexed to the Statuts.
required_dossiers: Final signed Statuts (original scanned copy)
Report of the commissaire aux apports, if in-kind contribution
Valid identity document of each shareholder or certifying explanation
Certificate of name availability (optional printout of the INPI search)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe questions the name or the Statuts, file a corrected version through the Guichet Unique mailbox; a defective appraisal report must be redone by the contributing shareholders before refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked deposit of the subscribed cash capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or a notary (depositary of the funds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked account in the name of the company being formed; transfer the paid-up portion of the cash subscriptions (at least 50%, but 100% recommended to simplify); obtain the certificate of the depositary listing each subscriber and the respective amounts; the funds are released only after registration.
required_dossiers: Account opening instruction for the blocked account
Subscription statement signed by each shareholder
Certificat du dépositaire des fonds (deposit certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is deficient or the amounts are misstated, request a corrected certificate; re-deposit of funds, if necessary, before filing the M0.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal notice publication in a journal of legal announcements
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the notice of incorporation (company name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, term, President) in an approved legal gazette; collect the attestation de parution which must be enclosed with the M0 filing.
required_dossiers: Statuts
Deposit certificate (certificat du dépositaire des fonds)
Draft legal announcement text
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the publication contains errors, publish a rectificatif in the same gazette and enclose both the original attestation and the rectification evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of the President and, if required, of the statutory auditor
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Formally appoint the President of the SAS and any Director(s) (Directeur général) as provided in the Statuts; the President signs a letter of acceptance and the legal representative's identification is established; where two of the three thresholds are exceeded (balance sheet total over €4 million, turnover over €8 million, over 50 employees), appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) who accepts the mandate.
required_dossiers: Shareholders' decision (procès-verbal of resolutions)
Signed letter of acceptance of the President with identity details
Letter of acceptance of the commissaire aux comptes, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If thresholds are miscalculated, a supplementary shareholder decision appoints or removes the auditor; late appointment is cured by filing a rectifying corporate act with the Greffe.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of the incorporation dossier before the Greffe via the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (INPI portal) and the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the dossier on formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr using the M0 declaration; upload all attachments, complete the beneficial-owner declaration, and pay the filing fee online by bank card; the Greffe verifies legal regularity and issues the K-bis extract evidencing legal personality.
required_dossiers: Completed M0 declaration (online)
Scanned final Statuts
Certificat du dépositaire des fonds
Attestation de parution of the legal announcement
Justificatif de jouissance du siège social (lease or authorization of the owner)
Identity documents of the President and natural shareholders
Beneficial-owners declaration (bénéficiaire effectif)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a Greffe query for missing or irregular documents, reply through the secured Guichet Unique mailbox within 15 days; failure to regularize leads to rejection and a new filing with new fees; a rectified Statuts version supersedes the earlier one.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration operational clearance and tax-social registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; INSEE; DGFiP (fiscal administration); URSSAF
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Retrieve the K-bis extract and SIREN registration; verify automatic issuance of the intra-Community VAT number; register the company as employer with URSSAF and activate the payroll account; acknowledge the NAF/APE code assigned to the manufacturing activity (2630Z).
required_dossiers: Extrait K-bis
SIREN/NAF certificate
Appointment decision and identity of the President for social registration
Employer declaration (URSSAF) and payroll setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VAT number is not issued, request DGFiP activation; a wrong NAF code is corrected through a rectifying amendment filed at the Greffe.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) as the ICPE inspectorate for the production site; ARCEP and ANFR for conformity and market surveillance of radio-frequency equipment; DDPP/DGCCRF for consumer and product-safety controls.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Déclaration de mise sur le marché d'équipements radioélectriques (RED notification under Directive 2014/53/EU, via the ANFR/ARCEP equipment declaration module) and the ICPE declaration/registration for the manufacturing plant.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL of the relevant département, with the Mission Autorité environnementale of the Conseil Général de l'Environnement et du Développement Durable (CGEDD) acting where a case-by-case EIA is requested.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration/Exempt (non-ICPE): standard SMT assembly and optical-terminal production does not require a full environmental impact assessment unless the solvent or surface-treatment thresholds of ICPE Rubrique 2940 are crossed or the site exceeds the case-by-case examination criteria of Article R.122-2 of the Environment Code (floor area above 10,000 m² or generation of hazardous waste above 1 metric ton per year).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to municipal sewer: pH between 5.5 and 9.5, temperature ≤ 30 °C, and compliance with the local déversement order; air emissions from soldering and cleaning: respect of the arrêté ministerial general emission limits with a solvent management plan where solvent consumption ≥ 0.6 t/year (Solvents Directive 1999/13/EC); hazardous WEEE and electronic-board scrap must be registered in the DREAL waste register and shipped under the documents for hazardous-waste movement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety compliance for the workplace: installation of detection and extinguishing systems, free egress paths, and a security notice, with a preventive inspection by the Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours (SDIS); building-stability attestation (attestation de solidité under Article R.111-38 of the Construction Code) for new or refurbished premises; electrical-installation conformity certificate and periodic electrical checks; occupational health: affiliation with a Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail, completion of the DUERP (single risk-assessment document), and electromagnetic-field measurement of the 5G router test benches at the thresholds of Article R.4453-7 of the Labor Code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SAS entities receive SIREN and SIRET automatically upon incorporation through guichet unique. Foreign-owned entities without French establishment must appoint a fiscal representative and register with DGFiP to obtain statutory TIN and VAT ID. Submission includes articles of association, proof of address, and identification documents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. France applies mandatory entity-level taxation under territorial scope. Limited hybrid mismatch rules apply under ATAD without elective mechanisms.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for all B2B transactions since October 2024. Invoices must use standardized XML format with digital signature and QR code. Real-time fiscal clearance via PEPITES platform with API integration for digital stamping and reporting.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to goods exported outside the European Union. Intra-EU supplies qualify under reverse charge mechanism. Eligibility requires proof that goods leave French territory and destination is non-EU or qualifying intra-EU transaction.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger retrospective VAT liability at standard rate, fines up to 80% of unreported VAT, interest charges, and potential criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a fully convertible regime for both current account transactions and capital movements under EU and international standards. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders face no restrictions or surrender obligations, subject solely to standard corporate tax compliance, beneficial ownership registration, and anti-money laundering verification. Capital account transactions, including equity injections and loan repayments, are unrestricted provided they comply with reporting thresholds to the Banque de France.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion of export proceeds is required. Exporters retain full control over foreign currency receipts, which may be held in offshore or domestic FX accounts. All export transactions necessitate customs declarations, VAT registration, and periodic reporting to the Direction Générale des Finances Publiques for tax and statistical purposes, with no statutory timeline for conversion or surrender.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for offshore digital electronic money institutions. French regulations under the Payment Services Directive and upcoming MiCA framework prohibit unlicensed cross-border EMI activities. Local French EMI licensing is mandatory for any digital wallet or payment services targeting French residents or involving euro clearing, with strict AML and capital requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors or authorized signatories is mandatory for initial KYC onboarding and face-to-face interviews at French commercial banks. Remote video KYC is permitted only for subsequent verifications or non-resident representatives, subject to Banque de France guidelines and enhanced due diligence protocols.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening failure on beneficial owners, directors, or ultimate beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official sanctions clearance certificates, source of wealth and source of funds statements, beneficial ownership declarations under French law, and independent verification reports from licensed auditors

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent beneficial ownership structure or PEP identification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated corporate register extracts, shareholding agreements, and notarized declarations of non-PEP status

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections are routed via SWIFT MT103 wires with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQTY'. Verification requires supporting documentation including board resolutions, share subscription agreements, and audited financial statements. All transactions exceeding €100,000 are automatically reported to the Banque de France for statistical purposes under the Balance of Payments framework.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements utilize SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers or Commercial Letters of Credit via correspondent banking networks. Telecom equipment exports require precise HS code classification (e.g., 8517.62 for routers), Incoterms application, and customs clearance. Purpose codes include 'TRADE' or specific export settlement codes, with full compliance to French export control regulations and VAT rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve annual accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end; deposit with the registry within 1 month of approval (maximum 7 months after year-end), unless a court-approved extension is obtained.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-deposit exposes the SAS to a legal entity fine up to EUR 15,000, possible periodic penalty payments, and a registrar-initiated strike-off procedure after formal notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale / déclaration de résultats)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year company, by the second business day after 1 May (normally 3 May); for a company with a fiscal year ending on any other date, within three months following the end of the fiscal year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers late-payment interest at 0.20% per month, an automatic 10% surcharge, increased to 20% after formal notice and 40% for deliberate concealment; prolonged failure may trigger ex officio tax assessment and refusal to issue tax clearance certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO confirmation declaration (déclaration de confirmation des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after the annual shareholders' meeting approving the accounts; even if no changes have occurred, a confirmation declaration must be filed to keep the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs current.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may result in a fine of up to EUR 15,000 for a legal entity, refusal by the registrar to issue an up-to-date RCS extract, and delays in regulatory filings leading to administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory for an SAS when at least two of the following thresholds are exceeded at fiscal year-end: balance sheet total over EUR 4,000,000; net turnover over EUR 8,000,000; average workforce over 50 employees. Mandatory group audit thresholds apply when the SAS controls a subsidiary that exceeds the same criteria. The articles of association may impose a lower audit threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Statutory annual accounts must be prepared in accordance with French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) as codified by the Code de commerce; consolidated accounts, where required, may use IFRS as adopted by the European Union.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The UBO declaration is filed at incorporation and updated within one month of any change in beneficial ownership, including shareholding transfers or changes in control. An annual confirmation declaration must additionally be filed within 15 days after the shareholders' meeting approving the annual accounts, even when no UBO information has changed. Share transfers that alter beneficial ownership must be reported and reflected in the updated UBO declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $800 - $2,200 per year for professional domiciliation and corporate secretarial agent services in France (Paris premiums may be higher).
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $5,000 - $15,000 per year for a certified statutory audit of a mid-sized SAS, depending on complexity and group structure.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (crédit d'impôt recherche, up to 30% of eligible R&D expenses) and innovation status (statut innovation) preferential deductions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1201 (Déclaration de résultat) filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (e.g., 31 March for calendar year fiscal year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents, include only profits attributable to French permanent establishment
Apply permanent establishment adjustments and treaty benefits where relevant

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax base and surtax computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust for cross-border repatriation and apply any available relief
